access_pathway_details.text: No CRISPR-based therapy offered in Próspera was identified. The best-known gene-therapy company there, Minicircle, ran a follistatin plasmid (non-CRISPR) phase I trial.

oversight_notes.text: Próspera describes its approach as avoiding onerous prescriptive regulation in favour of closely monitored self-regulation.
